nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Placeholder file to keep the benchmarks/data directory tracked in git when it contains no other committed files.

nodes.name: beam-128K.meta.json
nodes.summary: Metadata descriptor for the BEAM 128K benchmark dataset, recording version, instance count, chat size, source reference, canonicalisation details, and distribution by memory ability.

nodes.name: failure-mode-calibration-10.jsonl
nodes.summary: Small 18-line JSONL calibration dataset of 10 failure-mode examples used for benchmark harness calibration.

nodes.name: locomo-1540.jsonl
nodes.summary: Primary LoCoMo benchmark dataset containing 1,531 conversation evaluation instances used for measuring memory system recall accuracy.

nodes.name: locomo-1540.meta.json
nodes.summary: Metadata descriptor for the locomo-1540 dataset, recording version, instance count, source reference, canonicalisation rules, distribution statistics, and paper count verification.

nodes.name: longmemeval.meta.json
nodes.summary: Metadata descriptor for the LongMemEval benchmark dataset, recording version, variant, source, HuggingFace repository reference, canonicalisation, and question-type distribution.

nodes.name: preflight-locomo-50.json
nodes.summary: Preflight subset of 50 LoCoMo instances with metadata used for fast smoke-test runs before full benchmark execution.

nodes.name: final_state.jsonl
nodes.summary: Single-line JSONL artifact capturing the final agent state from the GAIA2 smoke-C2 oracle run on 2026-04-30.

nodes.name: initial_state.jsonl
nodes.summary: Single-line JSONL artifact capturing the initial agent state from the GAIA2 smoke-C2 oracle run on 2026-04-30.

nodes.name: output.jsonl
nodes.summary: Single-line JSONL output results from the GAIA2 smoke-C2 oracle run (smoke-A variant) on 2026-04-30.

nodes.name: benchmark_stats.json
nodes.summary: Statistics output from the GAIA2 smoke-B mock-thread run on 2026-04-30, recording metadata, run statistics, and configuration details.

nodes.name: output.jsonl
nodes.summary: Three-line JSONL output results from the GAIA2 smoke-B mock-thread run on 2026-04-30.

nodes.name: mutation-prompt-template-non-qwen.md
nodes.summary: Mutation oracle prompt template for non-Qwen models (Claude/GPT/generic) in the GEPA Faza-1 phase, including failure mode context, mutation guidance, semantic locks, and output format requirements.

nodes.name: mutation-prompt-template-qwen.md
nodes.summary: Mutation oracle prompt template specifically targeting Qwen model shapes in GEPA Faza-1, with empirical context, Qwen-specific failure modes, mutation guidance, and semantic lock constraints.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative specification for the GEPA (Tier 2 Prompt-Shapes Evolution) benchmark module, covering authority chain, substrate freeze anchors, baseline shape SHAs, per-shape fitness forks, false-positive guards, test structure, and acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: analyze-checkpoint-a.py
nodes.summary: Python analysis script for GEPA Faza-1 checkpoint A, computing inter-rater statistics (Cohen's kappa, raw agreement) and per-judge metrics across evaluation results.

nodes.name: kappa
nodes.summary: Computes Cohen's kappa inter-rater agreement between two judgment lists, used to measure judge consistency in GEPA evaluations.

nodes.name: cost-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: GEPA Faza-1 cost-tracking module that monitors cumulative USD spend against hard caps and internal halt thresholds, implementing super-linear overage detection and audit cadence triggers.

nodes.name: createCostTracker
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates a cost-tracker state object initialized with the baseline median cost per evaluation.

nodes.name: checkHaltTriggers
nodes.summary: Evaluates cost state against hard cap, internal halt threshold, and super-linear overage threshold, returning a halt decision with reason string when any trigger fires.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point or barrel module for GEPA Faza-1 source, organizing exports from the faza-1 implementation modules.

nodes.name: mutation-validator.test.ts
nodes.summary: Quarantined test suite for the GEPA mutation validator, verifying that mutated prompt shapes pass semantic integrity checks; currently disabled pending schema stabilization.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Explains why the faza-1 closed test directory exists, documents the quarantined files, rationale for quarantine, reactivation conditions, and audit trail for each disabled test.

nodes.name: registry-injection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Quarantined test suite for GEPA registry injection behavior, using a probe shape factory to verify shape registration and injection into the evaluation pipeline.

nodes.name: cost-tracker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Active test suite for the GEPA Faza-1 cost-tracker module, covering halt trigger logic, audit cadence, super-linear overage detection, and cost state transitions.

nodes.name: null-baseline-shape-override.test.ts
nodes.summary: Small test suite verifying that null baseline shape overrides are handled correctly in GEPA Faza-1 evaluation logic.

nodes.name: datasets.json
nodes.summary: Benchmark harness dataset registry defining five named datasets (synthetic, locomo, longmemeval, beam-128k, beam-1m) with their paths and configuration.

nodes.name: models.json
nodes.summary: Benchmark harness model registry defining 12 LLM model configurations including Qwen3.6, LLaMA 3.1, Claude Opus variants, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1, and Grok 4.20 with their endpoint and parameter settings.
